initial_source_scope: Ranking test/harness additions over the existing isolated next source. No structured-map budget repair yet; no protected matrix-initializer WIP. Rejected outlined-tail candidate had been removed before this full build.
original_json_policy: No paths, hashes, statuses or measurements rewritten. evidence.tar.gz retains the complete original directory; matrix.json.gz and smoke.json.gz are convenience copies.
payloads: All inputs, values and int64 indices included. Guard arrays were checked at execution, but the export only contains interior payloads.
byte_verification: evidence.tar.gz extracted into a fresh directory and diff -qr matched the entire raw directory before read-only audit.
independent_audit: audit.py on the extracted evidence passed 65 full output pairs and recomputed host medians. It does not rerun kernels or independently validate GPU counter records.
identity_limit: Executable, build/bin library and LLVM hashes retained; not all dynamically loaded external dependencies are recursively fingerprinted. Full binary/toolchain closure and actual ORC native-entry objects are not archived.
performance_status: Single-order screening under observed desktop coactivity, not a balanced ranking, calibrated policy, pure CPU kernel measurement or performance-goal acceptance. Later repair measurements must be separate.
